references.text: Moses expresses similar humility and inadequacy when God calls him to lead Israel out of Egypt.
Moses objects to his calling by pointing to his limitations, just as Gideon does here.
Saul responds with similar humility when he is appointed king, citing the low status of his family in Benjamin.
Jeremiah expresses the same kind of resistance to the call by pointing to his youth and inadequacy.
Paul writes about how God chooses what is weak and despised in the world to accomplish His will.
Jacob expresses his insignificance before God, a similar attitude of humility.
David was the youngest in his father's house, just as Gideon describes himself here.
